title: Single-Port Synchronous RAM
constraints: 64 × 8-bit memory. On a rising edge with `en = 1`: if `we`, write `wdata` to `addr`.
Registered read, **read-first**: on every enabled edge `rdata` gets the value stored at `addr` **before** this edge's write. With `en = 0` nothing changes.
No reset. Must be synthesizable (it should infer a block RAM).
hints: Write and read in the same clocked block with nonblocking assignments: `rdata <= mem[addr]` naturally reads the old value.
This is the canonical pattern FPGA tools recognize as block RAM.
Compare with the write-first memory of the Debug problem.
